summary.text: Mike Bernskoetter, a Republican, represents Missouri Senate District 6 (Cole, Camden, Miller, Moniteau and Morgan counties) and took the oath of office on January 9, 2019.
He chairs the Senate Fiscal Oversight Committee and the Joint Committee on Legislative Research.

paragraphs.text: Bernskoetter was born in Jefferson City, graduated from Helias High School, and is a lifelong Cole County resident.
He and his wife, Jeannette, have owned and operated Art's Pest Control since 1986 and also run a cow/calf farm operation.
He served eight years in the Missouri House representing the 59th District, first elected in 2010, before his election to the Senate.
He has been recognized as Missouri Cattlemen's Association 2019 Legislator of the Year and with the 2019 Missouri Corn Growers Association Public Service Award.
He previously served as president of the Missouri Pest Management Association.
Bernskoetter lives in Jefferson City; he and his wife have four children and eight grandchildren.
